author: DevOnBike
name: Overfit local-LLM chat (Minimal API)
description: A Minimal API streaming-chat app that loads a local GGUF model in-process with Overfit and exposes it as a standard Microsoft.Extensions.AI IChatClient — no Python, no Ollama, no Docker, no cloud key.

ModelPath.description: Path to a local GGUF model file. You can also change it later in appsettings.json.
